meta.title: Withdrawing Order...: Closing the window with Escape does not submit the withdrawal
gaps: Directly assert that the withdrawal reason was not submitted through the Yes button or that the event remains non-withdrawn; the catalog only provides a positive expect_withdrawn assertion.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly assert that the withdrawal reason was not submitted through the Yes button or that the event remains non-withdrawn; the catalog only provides a positive expect_withdrawn assertion.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary as the buyer.
Navigate to the RFQ Responses tab.
Open the stage Settings menu containing Withdraw.
Open the Withdrawing Order dialog without confirming it.

args.label: Please enter reason for withdrawing this event

steps.note: Dismiss the withdrawal dialog with Escape instead of pressing Yes.
Assert that the withdrawal dialog closed after Escape.
Verify Withdraw remains available, indicating Escape did not complete the withdrawal.
